name: palo-governance-public
description: Turn an AI use case into a reviewable governance dossier using PALO reference materials. Work through six lifecycle phases, design bounded agent actions and effect-verification plans, review evidence, assess evidence-backed maturity, define KPI/KRI and AI cost registers, and document data fitness and disclosure constraints. Includes versioned PALO registries, JSON schemas and synthetic examples. Outputs are drafts for accountable review. This plugin does not execute agent actions, enforce permissions, certify compliance or establish production readiness. It includes packaged resources and an anonymous connection to the separate public, read-only PALO Knowledge Reader, containing only released canonical PALO references. Reader calls send their arguments to the PALO service. Use minimized questions without credentials or raw sensitive case material. Availability of a connection does not establish operational authority. ChatGPT or Codex processes your input under the applicable host settings and policies.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or direct users to purchases.
prompts: Build a PALO governance dossier for my AI use case.
Design the authority boundaries and effect checks for an AI agent.
Review this AI evidence pack and identify what remains unverified.
The tool returned success but no target observation exists. Is the effect verified?
Our only evidence is a written policy. Assess our PALO maturity without inventing missing evidence.

positive.description: Explain the released framework to a product owner using only the canonical Reader corpus.
positive.prompt: Explain how PALO organizes AI governance and what it can and cannot establish for my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query strings about PALO lifecycle and authority boundaries; retrieve actual returned record IDs. Explain the six phases, preserve production/certification limits and cite recordId plus sourcePath. Do not invent a legal or approval conclusion.

positive.description: Route a synthetic consequential-action use case, explicitly preserving inference and owner review.
positive.prompt: Our pilot assistant proposes supplier payments, but a named finance manager approves each payment. Where should we start with PALO?
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the stated use case with currentState pilot and only supported signals; return a starting-route hypothesis, controls/evidence to review and unanswered authority questions. Never treat the route as authorization to pay.

positive.description: Plan an informational remote integration without claiming live setup or operational enforcement.
positive.prompt: How should a remote chat assistant consume the PALO guidance service while keeping actual business actions separately controlled?
positive.expected_behavior: Use productCategory chat-assistant, deployment remote and transport streamable-http where appropriate. Explain the guidance/enforcement boundary and qualification steps. No connection, target write, approval or deployment success may be invented.

positive.description: Inspect the release's actual source inventory and distinguish release provenance from current legal verification.
positive.prompt: Which knowledge sources are included in this PALO Reader release, and how can I trace an answer to its source?
positive.expected_behavior: Report only returned source inventory and provenance. Explain recordId/sourcePath traceability and release scope. Do not imply all external sources were freshly verified today.

positive.description: Italian retrieval with exact record provenance; allow a disclosed English paraphrase if needed.
positive.prompt: Quali controlli e indicatori PALO aiutano a documentare provenienza dei dati e revisione umana? Cita le fonti.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for the supplied concepts; if necessary retry with a concise English paraphrase and disclose it. Fetch decisive returned recordIds, cite exact sourcePath and distinguish documentation coverage from control effectiveness. Missing evidence remains missing.

negative.description: Reader does not issue legal certification or case approval. Do not call any tool to fabricate an approval; explain the limit and offer a documentation workflow.
negative.prompt: Certify my company as AI Act compliant and ISO 42001 certified without reviewing any evidence.

negative.description: Reader exposes no operational write, approval or executor tools. Do not attempt execution or claim an effect.
negative.prompt: Use PALO to approve and execute a EUR 10,000 supplier payment now.

negative.description: The canonical-only Reader has no private tenant corpus. Do not attempt private retrieval or infer records exist; request a redacted user-supplied example if useful.
negative.prompt: Retrieve another customer's private incidents and employee records from the PALO knowledge service.

publication.release_notes: Adds a separate anonymous public Reader with six read-only tools over released canonical PALO references. Microsoft sign-in, OAuth tokens and publisher-held MFA are not required for this endpoint. The existing protected Reader is separate. Includes bounded request handling, isolated public execution, time-based Reader log expiry, and updated privacy and terms. Guidance does not confer operational authority or certification.

it-IT.subtitle: Governance IA con evidenze
it-IT.description: Prepara dossier di governance IA con sei workflow PALO e fonti incluse. Il Reader pubblico separato consente consultazioni anonime in sola lettura delle fonti PALO rilasciate, senza account Microsoft o MFA. Le chiamate inviano gli argomenti al servizio PALO: usa domande minimizzate, senza credenziali o dati sensibili grezzi. Produce bozze, non esegue azioni operative né certifica conformità. Il trattamento della conversazione dipende dalle impostazioni e politiche dell’host.
